denominator_reconciliation.msci_definition: the Market Investable Equity Universe's free float-adjusted capitalization — every Taiwan security PASSING the investability screens (min size, float>=0.15, liquidity, foreign room), valued at price x shares x float factor (GIMI §2.2, §2.3.5). NOT the whole listed market: sub-screen names are excluded.
denominator_reconciliation.verdict: D2 ADOPTED as denominator-of-record (it is MSCI's own arithmetic inverted from the factsheet, same price vintage as our caps); D1 retained as bottom-up cross-check; cutoff-of-record = D2 line with D1 as band edge
denominator_reconciliation.challenge_credit: user challenged the modeled-body denominator; the better number existed in the factsheet all along
denominator_reconciliation.ill_conditioning_note: The crossing is ILL-CONDITIONED near the boundary: an 11% denominator gap moves the raw line from $6.7B to $11.2B because the cumulative curve is nearly flat in the tail. MSCI's own procedure absorbs this with slack the point-estimate hides: the coverage TARGET is an AREA (85% +/-5%, GIMI §2.3.1), the cutoff lives in the global corridor, and buffers retain members far below it. Practical consequence: candidate verdicts must be tested under BOTH frames; only frame-ROBUST verdicts ship as calls.
